Asset or process: Customer data in the production database
Risk description: An attacker phishes a support agent, reuses the credential and exports customer records, exposing personal data and triggering breach notification.
Threat: External attacker running a credential-phishing campaign
Vulnerability: Support console reachable from the internet with password-only sign-in
Treatment plan: Enforce phishing-resistant MFA on the support console, restrict export to a named role, and add an alert on bulk exports.

Risk description: Only one engineer can deploy or roll back production, so an outage during their absence extends well beyond the recovery objective.
Threat: Key-person unavailability — illness, leave or resignation
Vulnerability: Deployment knowledge and credentials held by a single person, undocumented
Treatment plan: Document the deployment runbook, give a second engineer the access and have them perform a supervised release each month.

Risk description: Email, documents and identity all sit with one provider, so a prolonged outage or account compromise there halts the business.
Threat: Supplier outage or compromise at the hosting provider
Vulnerability: No tested alternative for communications and no independent copy of key documents
Treatment plan: Accept the concentration risk for now; keep an independent encrypted export of critical documents and review at each management review.
